items.exampleEn: Growing up by the sea gave her a deep consciousness of nature's power.
items.exampleZh: 在海邊長大，讓她深刻意識到大自然的力量。

items.exampleEn: Patience is a virtue, especially when you are learning a new skill.
items.exampleZh: 耐心是一種美德，尤其是在學新技能的時候。

items.exampleEn: Some people believe money is the root of all evil.
items.exampleZh: 有些人認為金錢是萬惡之源。

items.exampleEn: Driving in the city during rush hour is a nightmare.
items.exampleZh: 尖峰時段在市區開車簡直是場惡夢。

items.exampleEn: My neighbor is a decent man who always helps others.
items.exampleZh: 我的鄰居是個正派的人，總是幫助別人。

items.exampleEn: The charity works to reduce the suffering of street animals.
items.exampleZh: 這個慈善團體致力於減少流浪動物的痛苦。

items.exampleEn: When the teacher asked who broke the window, nobody would confess.
items.exampleZh: 老師問是誰打破窗戶時，沒有人願意承認。

items.exampleEn: Mozart was a musical genius who wrote songs as a child.
items.exampleZh: 莫札特是音樂天才，小時候就會寫曲子。

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother taught me the virtue of working hard.
items.sentenceZh: 奶奶教會我勤奮的美德。

items.audioEn: The new train line is great, but building it was a nightmare for local shops.
items.audioZh: 新的鐵路線很棒，但興建期間對當地商店來說簡直是場惡夢。
items.questionZh: 對當地商店來說，興建新鐵路的過程如何？

items.sentenceEn: I have to confess that I forgot your birthday.
items.sentenceZh: 我得承認，我忘了你的生日。

items.sentenceEn: She earns a decent salary, but she still lives with her parents.
items.sentenceZh: 她的薪水還不錯，但仍然和父母同住。

items.stemEn: Our class has two math ____; they solve every problem in minutes.
items.stemZh: 我們班有兩個數學天才，每道題都幾分鐘就解出來。

items.stemEn: She finally ____ to being afraid of dogs.

items.passageEn: Our book club just finished a fantasy novel about a young girl who must stop an evil king. The writer is a genius at creating strange worlds, but some readers found the story too dark. The girl's journey is full of suffering, and one member admitted the book gave her nightmares. Still, most of us loved its message: kindness and honesty are virtues that can defeat any power. In the final chapter, the king confesses his crimes, and the girl chooses to forgive him. As a decent person, she believes everyone deserves a second chance. Our discussion became quite philosophical, and the book raised our consciousness about how we treat people who are different.
items.passageZh: 我們讀書會剛讀完一本奇幻小說，講一個年輕女孩必須阻止一位邪惡的國王。作者是創造奇特世界的天才，但有些讀者覺得故事太黑暗。女孩的旅程充滿苦難，有位成員坦言這本書讓她做了惡夢。不過，我們大多數人都很喜歡它傳達的訊息：善良和誠實是能戰勝任何權力的美德。在最後一章，國王坦承自己的罪行，女孩選擇原諒他。身為一個正派的人，她相信每個人都值得第二次機會。我們的討論變得很有哲理，這本書也讓我們更意識到該如何對待和自己不同的人。

questions.questionZh: 小說裡的女孩必須做什麼？
最後一章國王做了什麼？
options: 坦承了自己犯下的罪行

items.promptZh: 年輕人的健康意識正在提高。
referenceEn: Health consciousness is growing among young people.
Young people's health consciousness is rising.
rubricZh: consciousness 表示「意識」（例如 health consciousness；寫 awareness of… 意思也對）
「正在提高」可寫 is growing、is rising 等

items.instructionZh: 用 genius 造一個句子，說說你認識或欣賞的、在某方面很有天分的人。
referenceEn: My younger brother is a genius with computers.
I think my grandmother is a genius in the kitchen.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 genius（例如 a genius with…、a genius at…）
